source_warrant: An attested native volume-unit noun in the reviewed source scope defines a volume standard, capacity, or amount by volume. That positive definitional role is orthogonal to WANT. A person's use, preference, or aim involving the measured material does not define the amount. A source that defines a weight, a vessel, or a conative state requires separate treatment. The exact quarter.n.09 gloss defines a fraction of a hundredweight, so its volume ancestry does not license this volume-specific rule.
